title: 39. 도서관에선 조용조용, 쉿!
titleT: 39. Quiet, Quiet in the Library, Shh!

pages.ko: "도서관 간다! 신난다!" 호리는 엄마 손을 잡고 콩콩 뛰며 도서관 문을 열었어요. 넓은 방에 책이 산더미처럼 가득해요. 그런데 안은 어쩐지 아주아주 조용해요.
pages.t: "We're going to the library! Yay!" Hori held Mom's hand and hopped along as they opened the library door. The wide room was piled high with books. But somehow, it was very, very quiet inside.

pages.ko: 호리는 신이 나서 "우와아— 책 진짜 많다!" 큰 소리로 외치며 통통통 뛰어다녔어요. 책장 사이를 쿵쿵 달리고, 신발 소리도 저벅저벅. 엄마가 "호리야, 여기선…" 했지만 호리는 벌써 저만치 뛰어갔어요.
pages.t: Excited, Hori shouted loudly, "Wow— there are so many books!" and bounced around the room. He thumped down the aisles between the shelves, his shoes clomping loudly. Mom said, "Hori, here you should…" but Hori had already run off far away.

pages.ko: 호리 소리에 책 읽던 친구들이 깜짝 놀라 고개를 번쩍 들었어요. 어떤 친구는 읽던 줄을 놓쳐 "어디까지 봤더라…" 시무룩, 어떤 친구는 귀를 막았어요. 다들 호리를 쳐다봐요.
pages.t: The noise startled the children who were reading, and they all snapped their heads up. One friend lost his place and sighed, "Where was I again…" looking glum. Another friend covered her ears. Everyone stared at Hori.

pages.ko: 엄마가 살며시 다가와 호리 귀에 조그맣게 속삭였어요. "호리야, 여기 친구들도 조용히 책을 읽고 싶어 해. 네가 시끄러우면 친구들 마음도 시끄러워진단다." 호리는 볼이 발그레해졌어요.
pages.t: Mom came over quietly and whispered softly into Hori's ear. "Hori, the other children here want to read quietly too. When you're loud, it makes their hearts feel noisy as well." Hori's cheeks turned red.

pages.ko: 호리는 살그머니 자리에 앉아 좋아하는 그림책을 폈어요. 그런데 저쪽에서 다른 아이가 쿵쿵 뛰며 소리쳤어요. "우와아—!" 호리는 읽던 줄을 그만 놓쳤어요. "아! 이렇게 방해받는 거구나…" 아까 친구들 마음이 딱 이랬겠죠.
pages.t: Hori sat down quietly and opened his favorite picture book. But over there, another child stomped around, shouting, "Woohoo—!" Hori lost his place in the story. "Ah! So this is what it feels like to be interrupted…" That must be exactly how those other children had felt earlier.

pages.ko: 엄마가 살짝 웃으며 속삭였어요. "우리, 조용조용 요정 놀이 할까? 발끝으로 살금살금, 목소리는 아주 작게!" 호리 눈이 반짝 빛났어요. "좋아! 나 조용조용 요정 될래!" 여기선 조용조용, 살금살금.
pages.t: Mom smiled softly and whispered, "Shall we play the quiet fairy game? Tiptoe softly, and speak in a very small voice!" Hori's eyes lit up. "Yes! I'll be a quiet fairy!" Quiet, quiet, tiptoe soft, here in the library.

pages.ko: 호리는 발끝으로 살금살금 걸었어요. 하나, 목소리는 아주 작게 소곤소곤! 둘, 걸을 땐 살금살금! 셋, 책은 두 손으로 소중하게! 넘길 땐 살살, 사르륵. 여기선 조용조용, 살금살금.
pages.t: Hori tiptoed along softly. One, speak in a very small, hushed voice! Two, walk with soft, quiet steps! Three, hold books gently with both hands! Turn the pages slowly, with a soft rustle. Quiet, quiet, tiptoe soft, here in the library.

pages.ko: 호리가 조용히 책을 읽자, 아까 방해받던 친구들도 다시 편안하게 책에 빠져들었어요. 조용한 도서관이 참 아늑해요. 그 순간 호리 꼬리 줄무늬가 무지개색으로 반짝— 부릉! 조용조용 예절, 해냈어요!
pages.t: As Hori read quietly, the children who had been disturbed earlier were able to sink comfortably back into their books. The quiet library felt so cozy. At that moment, the stripes on Hori's tail sparkled in rainbow colors— vroom! He had mastered quiet manners!

pages.ko: 이제 호리는 알아요. 사람 많은 곳에선 어디서나 조용조용! 집에 오는 지하철에서도 호리는 소곤소곤 작은 목소리로 이야기하고, 자리에서 얌전히 앉아 있었어요. 여기선 조용조용, 살금살금.
pages.t: Now Hori knows to be quiet and gentle anywhere there are lots of people! Even on the subway ride home, Hori spoke in a soft, hushed voice and sat quietly in his seat. Quiet, quiet, tiptoe soft, here in the library.

pages.ko: 집에 온 호리를 엄마가 꼭 안아 주었어요. "우리 호리, 오늘 정말 멋진 조용조용 요정이었어!" 호리는 알아요. 내가 조용하면 다른 사람도 편안하다는 걸. 여기선 조용조용, 살금살금.
pages.t: When they got home, Mom gave Hori a big hug. "Our Hori was such a wonderful quiet fairy today!" Hori knows now: when I'm quiet, other people feel comfortable too. Quiet, quiet, tiptoe soft, here in the library.

overview.ko: 도서관에서 뛰고 떠들던 호리가 조용히 하기와 책 소중히 다루기를 배우는 공공장소 예절 동화입니다.
overview.t: This is a public-manners story about Hori, who used to run and shout in the library, learning to be quiet and to handle books with care.

lessons.t: Treat books and public spaces with care.

readingTips.ko: '조용조용, 쉿!' 후렴을 작은 목소리로 읽어 주세요.
readingTips.t: Read the refrain 'Quiet, quiet, shh!' in a small voice.
It's great to read this before visiting the library.
